claims.claim: target model fits the declared runtime capacity
claims.scope: exact model hash, quant, context and concurrency

claims.claim: sustained token generation meets the target
claims.scope: 30-minute repeated run on the declared backend

next.trigger: serving TTFT p95 exceeds declared SLO
next.action: run queue/KV capacity diagnosis before changing hardware

later.trigger: runtime capacity headroom falls below the declared threshold
later.action: re-evaluate quant, model size or GPU topology

non_claims: ACCEPT does not prove universal optimality
the sustained test does not prove multi-year reliability
current backend evidence does not prove future-version compatibility
